analysis_metadata.target_spec: Telegram-driven classifieds board with Django HTMX MPA

findings.reason: Directly supports US-B2 (Search) and US-B3 (Filter). Search is primary discovery method for buyers without registration.
findings.integration_notes: Persistent search bar in header. HTMX partial updates for search results. Query translated Montenegrin→Russian before FTS. Autocomplete suggestions via HTMX endpoints.

findings.reason: Directly supports US-B4 (Ad card) and US-B6 (Browse by category). Visual hierarchy with image, price, title is essential for classifieds browsing.
findings.integration_notes: CSS Grid with auto-fit for responsive columns. Each card links to ad detail. HTMX for infinite scroll/pagination. Telegram photos displayed via stored file URLs.

findings.reason: Supports US-B3 (Filter) but HTMX MPA architecture requires adapted approach. Cannot use traditional desktop sidebar for mobile-first.
findings.integration_notes: Desktop: sticky filter panel in sidebar. Mobile: HTMX-triggered bottom sheet or slide-out drawer. Filters combinable without full page reload. Category/city/price as core filters.

findings.reason: Supports US-B3 (Filter) with required active filter management. Essential for usability with multiple filter combinations.
findings.integration_notes: HTMX updates applied filters as removable chips. Filter state maintained in URL parameters for bookmarking. Clear all option available.

findings.reason: Supports US-B3 (Filter) but HTMX MPA works better with dual input sliders. Need simpler implementation than JavaScript-heavy sliders.
findings.integration_notes: HTML range inputs with min/max number fields alongside. HTMX on change triggers partial update. Consider Alpine.js for enhanced slider experience without SPA overhead.

findings.reason: Directly supports US-B6 (Browse by category) and US-B3 (Filter). Closed admin tree via django-mptt requires structured navigation.
findings.integration_notes: Dropdown/mega-menu for desktop. Collapsible tree for mobile. Bot suggests top 3-5 categories by keyword. Web uses full mptt tree with lazy loading.

findings.reason: Supports US-B7 (Browse by city) but limited to closed preset list of Montenegro cities, not dynamic geo-based search.
findings.integration_notes: City dropdown from closed list, not GPS-based. 'Did you mean' suggestions via difflib on typos. Exact match required, no fuzzy geo-matching.

findings.reason: Essential for classifieds UX. Supports US-B4 (Ad card) with clear pricing information.
findings.integration_notes: Price prominently displayed on card (blue/violet). Currency symbol localized. Full price visibility on all ad displays, never hidden.

findings.reason: Directly implements US-B5. Contact via deep-link to bot without revealing PII. Rendered only when ad PUBLISHED and seller valid.
findings.integration_notes: Button links to t.me/<bot_username>?start=contact_<ad_id>. No seller identity shown. HTMX endpoint checks ad status and seller validity for button visibility.

findings.reason: Contradicts decision C (US-B4/B5) - no seller identity shown on site. Trust signals work through bot contact, not on-site badges.
findings.integration_notes: Not applicable. Seller verification happens in Telegram bot. Trust is inferred through platform use, not displayed badges.

findings.reason: Contradicts decision C - no seller identity on site. Ratings would identify sellers.
findings.integration_notes: Not implemented in phase 1. Would require user accounts and ratings system which conflicts with anonymous buyer experience.

findings.reason: Supports US-S2 (Photos) and US-B4 (Ad card). 1-5 Telegram-compressed photos need display.
findings.integration_notes: Simple carousel or grid of photos. No server-side optimization in phase 1 - serve Telegram-compressed images as-is. Click to expand modal for larger view.

findings.reason: Directly supports US-B2 and US-B7. Prominent search is primary discovery for unregistered buyers.
findings.integration_notes: Central search bar in hero section. City selector dropdown (closed Montenegro list). Voice search optional. HTMX form submission for instant results.

findings.reason: Supports US-B6 but simplified. No social integration needed, icons for navigation only.
findings.integration_notes: Simple icon + text grid linking to category pages. No Facebook-style social proof. Use Heroicons or similar for consistent iconography.

findings.reason: Directly implements US-S1. QR/code page encoding login_<token> deep-link for Telegram authentication.
findings.integration_notes: Login button opens QR page. Generated token stored in login_tokens table. Bot writes telegram_id on claim. Create/find pattern for accounts.

findings.reason: Handled entirely by Telegram bot (US-S2). Not applicable to web interface which has no ad creation.
findings.integration_notes: Not needed for web. Bot handles step-by-step as DRAFT status in shared ORM. Web only displays PUBLISHED ads.

findings.reason: Essential for US-B8 and US-B9. Mobile-first design required for classifieds browsing.
findings.integration_notes: Expandable cards showing essential info first. Collapsible details on ad pages. Show/hide filter panels. Touch targets 44px minimum.

findings.reason: Supports US-B8 (Responsive UI) and US-B4 (Ad card). 44px minimum touch targets required.
findings.integration_notes: Cards 48-72px minimum tap targets. Adequate spacing between interactive elements. Thumb-zone optimized for mobile actions.

findings.reason: Supports US-B3 mobile experience but HTMX MPA requires hybrid approach.
findings.integration_notes: Filter button triggers HTMX modal. Slide-up panel from bottom. Apply/clear actions via HTMX. Sticky apply button for accessibility.

findings.reason: Supports performance for ad display. Critical for mobile users on slower networks.
findings.integration_notes: Lazy loading for off-screen images. No server optimization in phase 1. WebP format preferred. Loading skeleton states for perceived performance.

findings.reason: Deferred to post-MVP. Not in phase 1 specification. Adds complexity for MVP.
findings.integration_notes: Defered per spec. Focus on core web experience first. Consider for phase 1.5 or later enhancement.

findings.reason: Not in phase 1 specification. Only Telegram photos supported (US-S2 requires photos 1-5).
findings.integration_notes: Deferred feature. Phase 1 uses Telegram-compressed JPEG only. Video support would require separate media handling.

findings.reason: Overkill for MVP. Not in phase 1 specification. Requires user tracking which may conflict with anonymity goals.
findings.integration_notes: Deferred. Phase 1 focuses on basic search and category browsing. Personalization adds infrastructure complexity.

findings.reason: Future trends not in phase 1. Overengineering for MVP classifieds platform.
findings.integration_notes: Explicitly deferred. Phase 1 MVP focuses on core browsing and search functionality.

findings.reason: Nice for discovery but not required by user stories. Simple query-based suggestions suffice.
findings.integration_notes: Show related ads by same category. Simple query-based, not AI-powered. Horizontal scroll on mobile, grid on desktop.

findings.reason: Supports US-B2 and US-B3. Search must remain accessible during scroll.
findings.integration_notes: Header remains visible on scroll. Filter toggle accessible. Language switcher in header. HTMX partial updates.

findings.reason: Supports US-B6/US-B7. HTMX MPA works best with hybrid approach - pagination with HTMX partial loading.
findings.integration_notes: Use pagination with HTMX lazy loading. 'Load more' button pattern. Avoid true infinite scroll for SEO and back-button consistency.
